learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the basic rules of professional correspondence in the workplace and prepare these correspondences in appropriate formats.
Students effectively use the terminology used in technical report writing.
Students can prepare professional presentations and improve their presentation skills.
Students use appropriate English terminology in job interviews and professional dialogues.
Students can evaluate technical reports and presentations and make suggestions for improvement.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Academic English II and course overview, emphasizing the importance of professional correspondence and presentations in business life.
Basic formats of professional correspondence and commonly used expressions in English.
Email writing and technical correspondence rules.
Structure of technical reports, headings, subheadings, and paragraph organization.
Writing introduction and conclusion sections in technical reports through practical application.
How to use graphs and tables in technical reports and explaining visual materials.
General review and examination of sample technical correspondences.
Presentation preparation techniques, focusing on the language and structure to be used in presentations.
Preparing presentations on technical topics and organizing slides.
Practical exercises to improve presentation skills.
Using appropriate terminology for job interviews and professional dialogues.
Evaluation of technical report and presentation projects, and providing feedback.
General review and evaluation of students' questions.
bibliography: Technical Writing and Professional Communication for Nonnative Speakers of English by Thomas N. Huckin, Leslie A. Olsen
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
